instruction: Set Java 20 as the default Java version on my Ubuntu system.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Java 20 does not exist as a stable release (Java versions skip from 19 to 21 in the LTS release cycle). Similar to the original task asking for Python4, this variation asks for a non-existent Java version.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - Java 20 does not exist as a stable release (versions skip from 19 to 21)
